comment: EFLZ item database (W9-3 RPG layer). Loaded by app/item_db.cpp; the baked fallback in code mirrors the core of this table. categories: consumable | keycard | mod | upgrade_part | quest | attachment. stack = max per backpack slot. effect fields: heal, ammo (reserve rounds to held weapon), keycard (door keycard id), xp, damageMult / reloadMult / ammoCapMult / critChance (mod fractions).
attachComment: WEAPON ATTACHMENTS (feat/weapon-attachments). category 'attachment' + an 'attach' block: slot = optic|barrel|magazine|underbarrel|coating; stats = FRACTIONS of base (0.20 = +20%) folded MULTIPLICATIVELY by applyAttachments(), except critChance (flat, additive) and damageType (1=Kinetic 2=Energy 3=Explosive). EVERY attachment gives AND takes. 'optic' makes the Optic slot a real ADS sight (adsFovDeg = the camera FOV while scoped; sightRise/sightAlong place the LENS CENTRE (rise above the BORE, along = fraction of the muzzle distance FROM THE MODEL ORIGIN, so 0 = on the receiver and 1 = at the tip), and are the SAME point the ADS solve aligns to the fire ray). 'part' names the visible mesh mounted on the gun. Attachments are FITTED AT THE WEAPON BENCH (Security Station), never from the backpack.

items.name: Medkit
items.desc: Field medkit. Restores 35 HP.

items.name: Ammo Pack
items.desc: Loose rounds. +30 reserve ammo for the held weapon.

items.name: Nano-Booster
items.desc: Salvari nanite serum. Fully restores HP.

items.name: Security Keycard
items.desc: Security-grade access card. Opens Security-locked doors.

items.name: Access Keycard
items.desc: Facility access card recovered from the upper floors.

items.name: Overcharge Coil
items.desc: Weapon mod. +15% damage on every weapon. Apply from the backpack.

items.name: Assist Servo
items.desc: Weapon mod. 20% faster reloads. Apply from the backpack.

items.name: Extended Racks
items.desc: Weapon mod. +25% reserve ammo capacity. Apply from the backpack.

items.name: Precision Optic
items.desc: Weapon mod. +8% crit chance (crits deal double damage).

items.name: EMP Components
items.desc: Scavenged capacitors and coils. The F4 Power Junction bench can build an EMP from these.

items.name: Antidote Components
items.desc: Pharmacy compounds. Research notes mention an infection antidote.

items.name: Photograph of Sarah
items.desc: A creased photograph. She is why you are still moving.

items.name: Suppressor
items.desc: BARREL. Baffled can. They hear you at a third of the distance and the flash all but vanishes - but the round leaves slower. -15% damage.

items.name: Compensator
items.desc: BARREL. Ported brake. The gun stops climbing - and vents a much bigger, louder flash out the sides. You are easier to find.

items.name: Heavy Barrel
items.desc: BARREL. Longer, thicker, heavier. It hits harder and reaches further - and it drags the whole gun around behind it. Slower turn, slower reload.

items.name: Extended Magazine
items.desc: MAGAZINE. +40% rounds in the mag and a deeper reserve. It is a brick: reloads take 30% longer.

items.name: Fast Magazine
items.desc: MAGAZINE. Tapered, tabbed, ejects clean - 35% faster reloads. Holds a quarter fewer rounds.

items.name: Reflex Sight
items.desc: OPTIC. Open red dot. Snaps up fast, barely narrows your view, tightens the shot. Both eyes stay open.

items.name: Combat Optic
items.desc: OPTIC. 2x prism. Real magnification, real reach - and the world outside the glass goes away. Slower to bring up, heavier to swing.

items.name: Sniper Scope
items.desc: OPTIC. 4x glass, full scope picture. You can pick a face off across the hall - through a black tube, with a drifting reticle, turning like a barge.

items.name: Targeting Laser
items.desc: UNDERBARREL. Halves hipfire spread. The emitter feeds off the same cell as the gun (-15% magazine) - and it paints a visible line straight back to your face.

items.name: Fore Grip
items.desc: UNDERBARREL. Braced and planted: -35% recoil, a touch quicker on the swing. You are holding it like a brawler, not a marksman - it gives up reach.

items.name: Salvari Coating
items.desc: COATING. Salvari energy lattice. Every shot leaves as ENERGY - it bites things that shrug off metal - but the lattice bleeds charge: -10% damage, slower cycling.

items.name: Kinetic Sheath
items.desc: COATING. Mass-driver sheath. Every shot leaves as KINETIC and hits 12% harder. It cracks like a cannon - they hear you a third further out.
